method: Historical 2019Q2 V1.5 deep replay using current model/search. Company mappings, route eligibility and all selection states are frozen before post-cutoff returns are opened.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
Only evidence available by 2019-06-30 is retained.
The first V1.5 holdout diagnoses route precision/recall; it is not clean forward alpha validation.
